content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for CUP Contractual Faculty Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CUP Contractual Faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply for the Contractual Faculty position at Central University of Punjab is 22 September 2026. Candidates are encouraged to attend the walk-in interview on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Contractual Faculty post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess Bachelor's and Master's Degrees in relevant disciplines with First Class in either of the two degrees to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Contractual Faculty position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 64,000 per month for the Contractual Faculty post.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the Contractual Faculty position at CUP?
faq.answer: The application process is through a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to report to the specified venue on the interview date with all required documents.

faq.question: Q5. What is the total number of vacancies announced?
faq.answer: Central University of Punjab has announced a total of 1 vacancy for the Contractual Faculty post.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 100/- for General/OBC candidates. SC/ST and Women candidates are exempted from paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the interview venue for the Contractual Faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: The interview will be held at Central University of Punjab, Bathinda, Punjab - 151401. Please refer to the official notification for the exact reporting time and specific location within the university.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies of educational certificates, ID proof, and category certificates (if applicable), along with recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Please refer to the official notification for specific age limit details. Age relaxation policies may apply as per government norms.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for the Contractual Faculty role?
faq.answer: The selection process includes an Online Application, Walk-in Interview, Document Verification, and a PPT Presentation.
